item.title: [−1] IEA sees India's gas demand falling 2% in 2026 despite a 10% jump in LNG imports
item.description:
High prices and supply disruption suppress consumption even as imports rise. New outlook.

Agri & fertilisers: mild headwind (−1) — Costly feedstock

Why it matters: Weak gas demand at high prices hurts gas distributors and fertiliser makers' margins, and raises the import bill per unit used.
